pattern: 途中で/途中に（とちゅうで/とちゅうに）
aliases: とちゅうで/とちゅうに
purpose: Locate an event partway through a journey or activity.
keywords: Verb dictionary form + 途中で / 途中に; noun + の途中で / の途中に
I met a friend on my way home.
I took a break partway through work.
There is a small bridge on the way to the station.
formation: Verb dictionary form + 途中で / 途中に; noun + の途中で / の途中に
restrictions: 途中で often introduces an event; 途中に can identify a place along a route.
mistake: It marks a stage before completion, not necessarily the exact midpoint.
